cases.why: the season in progress is cached like a finished one. The canary would read week 1's play-by-play all season and never see a later week go missing, which is the thing it is there to notice.

cases.why: separately fetched seasons are stacked strictly instead of the way nflreadpy stacks them. A column only one season has, or a type that differs between seasons, would then break or change the frame, and the cache would change the ratings.
the weekly run starts reading cached play-by-play. The run that makes picks must always fetch fresh, so a stale cache can cost a canary night at worst, never a pick.
